name: Carrion Helmet Stalker
description:
Forged from scavenged metals and ragged clothes, the Carrion armor is a crude concoction of repurposed materials that demonstrates you'll do anything it takes to survive. The helmet features a high comb of iron bars and a faceplate framed by menacing pieces of Vanduul armor. 

The Stalker variant has been tagged with orange paint, and features a long cape and integrated pieces of Vanduul armor plating.
